name: Storage returns the querying tenant's transactions, not a hardcoded one
note:
The cube SQL contained `where t.ad_client_id=1000036` - a HARDCODED TENANT. Every other tenant saw an empty cube; tenant 1000026 alone has 7,579,460 m_transaction rows and got none of them. This measure returned 0.

Two more faults sat on the same line: the DATE filter was also applied to t.m_product_id, a product id, and dead experiments were left beside it - ad_client_id=11, a movementdate literal, M_Product_ID=1116440 and 1116428.

Found by reading WHERE clauses while closing the coverage gap, not by any failing test - nothing had ever queried this cube.
referenceSql: SELECT round(sum(t.movementqty),3) AS value FROM m_transaction t JOIN m_locator l ON l.m_locator_id=t.m_locator_id WHERE t.ad_client_id=1000026 AND t.movementdate >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND t.movementdate < DATE '2026-02-01'
